definitions.explanation: Unwanted sexual advances, comments, or behavior in the workplace or other settings that creates a hostile or uncomfortable environment.

examples.japanese: セクハラ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絶対|ぜったい}に→絶対に：08722_zettaini⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
セクハラ⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: He got in trouble for sexual harassment remarks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧セクハラ⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}した→連絡：01524_renraku⟧。
examples.english: I contacted the workplace sexual harassment consultation desk.

notes:
セクハラ is a Japanese abbreviation of セクシャル⟦ハラスメント→ハラスメント：11288_harasumento⟧ (sexual harassment). This type of abbreviation (taking the first two morae of each word) is very common in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- セクハラ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to experience sexual harassment
- セクハラ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: sexual harassment damage/victimization
- セクハラ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: sexual harassment countermeasures
- セクハラ⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧: sexually harassing remark
- セクハラ⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: harassment consultation desk
- セクハラ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧: to sue for sexual harassment

RELATED ～ハラ WORDS:
Japanese has coined many compound harassment terms:
- ⟦パワハラ→パワハラ：05904_pawahara⟧: power harassment (workplace bullying by a superior)
- ⟦モラハラ→モラハラ：06466_morahara⟧: moral harassment (psychological abuse)
- ⟦マタハラ→マタハラ：08788_matahara⟧: maternity harassment (discrimination against pregnant women)
- ⟦アルハラ→アルハラ：29041_aruhara⟧: alcohol harassment (pressuring someone to drink)
